text.card: Choose a trio whose color, shape and count are each all equal or all different.
text.read_choices: Read first, second and third and choose a form for the current pair. An incomplete pair can be changed or cleared.
text.empty_hands: Put down what you hold before using the feature-trio board.
text.rules: Each feature is checked separately: the three colors must be all equal or all different, and the same is required of shapes and symbol counts. Two equal and one different fails that feature. Choose distinct fixed card IDs for first and second, then an offered completion. A completion not offered for that pair is unavailable, not a generic validator result.
text.bank: Fixed bank: 1 blue three squares; 2 orange two squares; 3 purple two discs; 4 purple one triangle; 5 purple one square; 6 purple three squares. Cards 1 to 3 are the far row, 4 to 6 the near row.
text.display: Card IDs stay fixed above their feature symbols. A dark lower-left tab means first choice, lower-middle second, lower-right third; the shared 1/2/3 tab-position legend is near the front. Inspect first, second and third for exact IDs; 0 means unselected. The cards and tabs are integral mounted indicators.
text.first_trio: Choose first 1, second 2, then complete with 5: colors differ, all shapes are square, and counts differ. Changing first clears second and third; changing second clears third. Clear choices restores no tabs and leaves every card fixed.
text.second_trio: Choose first 3, second 4, then complete with 6: all colors are purple, shapes differ and counts differ. Both valid count patterns are all-different; this fixed bank has no all-same-count trio.
text.backtrack: First 1 and second 3 have no legal completion. Change second to 2 and complete with 5, or choose a new first or clear. The only valid unordered triples in this bank are 1/2/5 and 3/4/6; all ordered choices of each are available.
text.source: The equal-or-distinct feature rule follows the publisher SET rules, whose Easy Start removes shading. This original six-card mounted practice variation uses circles, triangles and squares instead of copied source artwork.
text.limits: This is a fixed-bank feature relation trainer, not the full dealt game. No shading, score, turn, winner, random dealing, history, solver, card custody or portable output. Legal completion follows the stored choices; the board does not validate arbitrary cards or free text.
